results.title: Idaho Fish and Game Commissioner Brody Harshbarger resigns following plea agreement
results.description: Embattled Idaho Fish and Game Commissioner Brody Harshbarger has resigned from the commission after agreeing to plead guilty to misdemeanor hunting charges, state records show.

results.title: Fairhaven Votes 92-77 to Ban Flock Cameras, but State Gets Final Say
results.description: Fairhaven Town Meeting voted 92-77 to ban police license plate readers, but the Massachusetts attorney general must still review the bylaw.

results.title: Judge blocks USDA secretary from sending religious emails from official account
results.description: The judge said certain emails sent by Secretary Brooke Rollins amounted to coercion and violated employees' constitutional rights.
